About Velositol.co

Health information should be useful before it is persuasive.

We publish plain-language education about protein nutrition, supplement formats, branded ingredients, and research interpretation.

Our purpose

Help readers ask better questions

Supplement content often moves quickly from a study result to a buying conclusion. Velositol.co slows that process down. We explain what an ingredient is, how a product format works, what a label discloses, and which questions remain unanswered.

Our content is educational. It is not individualized medical advice and should not replace care from a qualified healthcare professional.

What readers can expect

  • Clear publication and update dates
  • Source lists attached to relevant articles
  • Plain disclosure of commercial relationships
  • No invented medical-review credentials
  • Corrections when material facts change
